items.title: Mortgage Rates Move Lower Thanks to Record Low Pending Home Sales
items.author: Colin Robertson
items.content: Mortgage rates are a little better today, but it might not be worth celebrating. The reason isn’t great, as it typically isn’t. This time it’s pending home sales, which just hit a fresh record low going all the way back to 2001. That pushed bond yields lower on the day, which will translate to slightly… Read More »

items.title: Fannie Mae Ups 2027 Mortgage Rate Forecast to 7.5%
items.author: Colin Robertson
items.content: Each month, Fannie Mae releases a forecast for home prices, sales, and mortgage rates, among other things. Between September’s report and October’s, they raised their estimate for the 30-year fixed a staggering 80 basis points (0.80%). The unusually large move reflects just how bad mortgage rates had it over the past month and change. But… Read More »

items.title: Mortgage Rates Keep Falling on AI Rout, But Will It Last?
items.author: Colin Robertson
items.content: Mortgage rates have now fallen for five days in a row. That puts the average 30-year fixed mortgage around 7.375%, a three-week low and roughly a quarter point below where they were earlier this month. items.title: Mortgage Rate Winning Streak Comes to an End
items.author: Colin Robertson
items.content: Well, what we didn’t want to happen, happened. We got a hotter-than-expected CPI report this morning, sending bond yields surging higher. After three straight days of slightly-better mortgage rates, there was some real promise we could make a more meaningful move back toward the low-7s.
